item.title: Will Africa's Solar Demand Fill US Gap For China?
item.description: The global solar energy landscape is undergoing a tectonic shift, driven by geopolitical manoeuvres in the West and urgent development needs in the Global South. item.title: Canadian Solar Subsidiary CSI Solar To Transfer US Assets To Parent Firm To Derisk
item.description: CSI Solar, a 75% owned subsidiary of Ontario, Canada based Canadian Solar, will set up two joint ventures with Canadian Solar: one for its US solar business and one for its US energy storage business. CSI Solar, established in 2009 in China as a subsidiary by Canadian solar, is based in Suzhou, China. item.title: Uttarakhand Updates Renewable Tariff Rules, Opens Path for BESS Projects
item.description: Uttarakhand Electricity Regulatory Commission (UERC) has issued the Second Amendment Regulations, 2025, revising tariffs and other terms related to renewable energy supply and Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. item.title: Websol, Linton Partner to Explore Ingot And Wafer Manufacturing in India
item.description: Kolkata-based Websol Energy System, a solar cell and module manufacturer, has entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Linton, a global solar ingot and wafer equipment technology, to drive backward integration across the solar value chain. item.title: India Achieves 50% Non-Fossil Power Capacity Milestone, Accelerates Drive Toward Net Zero
item.description: India has achieved a major clean energy milestone, with non-fossil fuel sources now accounting for over 50 percent of its total installed electricity generation capacity. The country’s total installed capacity has reached 5,05,023 MW, comprising 2,45,600 MW from fossil-fuel sources and 2,59,423 MW from non-fossil fuel sources - including 2,50,643 MW from renewable energy. item.title: What Is Slowing the Mass Adoption of Sodium-Ion Batteries? IRENA Explains
item.description: A latest report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) showed a trend indicating that sodium-ion batteries (SIBs), which share a similar construction to lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), could become a potential alternative.
